notice.label: Complaints Book
notice.text: Under Peru's Consumer Protection Code, {name} provides a virtual Complaints Book (Libro de Reclamaciones) for you.

page.title: Complaints Book (Libro de Reclamaciones)
page.description: {name}'s virtual Complaints Book under Peruvian Law 29571. File a claim or complaint without creating an account.
page.intro: Under Peru's Consumer Protection and Defense Code, {name} provides this virtual Complaints Book (Libro de Reclamaciones). You don't need an account or a booking to use it. If you need help filling it in, message us on WhatsApp at {whatsapp}.
page.spanishForm: The official complaint form is in Spanish, as required by Peruvian regulations. You may write your complaint in English.

help.section1: Identification of the consumer filing the complaint
help.section2: Identification of the contracted good or service
help.section3: Details of the complaint and consumer's request
help.isMinor: I am a minor (the details of my parent or legal guardian are required).
help.goodDescription: Description of the service or product
help.responseChannel: How do you want to receive the answer?

hints.phone: A Peruvian mobile number or one with the country code (+1…).
hints.emailConfirm: We will send the copy of the form and the answer here.
hints.claimedAmount: It can be 0 if you are not claiming an amount.
hints.goodDescription: For example: tour, date and number of travelers.
hints.bookingCode: If you have one, it looks like PWT-2026-000123. It is not required.
hints.detail: Tell us what happened, when and with whom. You may write in English.

form.connectionError: We could not register your complaint. Check your connection and try again.
form.serverErrorTitle: We could not register your complaint:
form.unknownNote: If you are not sure, we will review it and process it as a claim (reclamo).

definitions.reclamo: Claim (reclamo): dissatisfaction related to the products or services.
definitions.queja: Complaint (queja): dissatisfaction not related to the products or services, or discontent with customer service.

form.conformity: I declare that the information in this form is true and that I agree with its content. This statement replaces my signature.

legends.first: Filing a claim does not prevent you from using other dispute resolution channels and is not a prerequisite for filing a report with INDECOPI.
legends.second: The provider must answer the claim or complaint within no more than fifteen (15) business days; this period cannot be extended.

form.privacy: We will use this data only to handle your claim or complaint and answer you, as required by Peru's Consumer Protection and Defense Code, and we will keep it for at least 2 years. We record the date, time and IP address of the submission. More information in the <link>Privacy policy</link>.
form.submit: Submit complaint form (Enviar hoja de reclamación)

receipt.copySent: We will send a copy to {email}. Save or print this record (in Spanish, as required by Peruvian law); we will answer no later than {date}.
